scope: Actual public production TIE/ln, Venator and Imperial I hardware. One factory build per reference, or an explicitly identified production blueprint with exactly matching source hashes. TIE uses the canonical craftPowerProfile used by the craft runtime blueprint path; capital ships use fleetProfile. No table estimates, private uploads, artificial damage, changed heat/fuel constants or seeded velocities. The cold allocations are separate new units. The 120-second runs start at rest and use actual finite power, heat, fuel and motion processing; no geometry/statistics are rebuilt during those runs.

conditions.mode: propulsion priority; full forward throttle; weapons and shields request zero
conditions.thermal: Normal emission, real installed cooling and ordinary crew, cold start. Not a heat-equilibrium or endurance guarantee.
conditions.browser: This Node evidence is separate from native Worker/WebGL/browser verification.

limitations: Imperial is an additional comparison, not a third hard calibration anchor: actual hardware supplies 2163.756 G under the common law, -5.924% relative to the approximate 2300 G reference. Its actual computed speed and published historical 60 MGLT metadata are recorded separately. Finite mechanical/electrical constraints are retained and listed.
